ruleUpdate: HPE OCA does not validate Synergy inter-frame or northbound cabling. Enforce 6-plane completeness via synergy_cabling_auditor.js: (1) Internal midplane (blades & Composer2 = 0 cables); (2) Frame power jumpers (P44712-B21 ships with C13-C14 cords and requires AF590A C20-C13 jumpers for C20 PDUs); (3) FLM 876852-B21 HA ring needs 0/2/3 10GbE SFP+ LINK DACs or optics for 1/2/3 frames plus 2x MGMT uplinks (e.g. 453154-B21) per ring, and never raw CAT6A without 813874-B21; (4) Ethernet 300Gb ICL needs 2x CXP28 cables per 50Gb ILM (867793-B21) for full 50Gb (0/4/8 for 1/2/3 frames) with zero LSZH/Plenum mixing; (5) Master F32 Q7/Q8 horizontal stacking requires 2x 100Gb QSFP28 cables per pair (BiDi optics forbidden in Q7/Q8), and total stacking + uplink QSFP28 endpoints must fit within 8 cages per F32; (6) Brocade FC Q2E57A/P77653-B21 ship with 4x SW optics and 0 fiber cables, requiring OM4 LC/LC or MPO breakout cables.
